title: Volatility
subtitle: Equity indices and commodities: realized vs implied
headline: Wednesday 25 November 2026. VIX 28.3 (very high), realized 31.0%, spread -2.7 points, curve in backwardation. The market charges +5.5 points over the HAR+IV model. Top idea: sell WTI vol at the OVX level.

sections.title: S&P 500 volatility
paragraphs: The VIX closed at 28.3, the 98th percentile of its trailing year (very high). The S&P 500 realized 31.0% over the last 21 sessions (99th percentile) and 19.7% over 63. Implied sits 2.7 points below realized: options are cheap against recent history.

Since 2015 the one-month variance premium (implied today minus realized over the next 21 days) averaged +3.5 points and was positive on 83% of days. Today's -2.7 spread is below that average: the seller is paid less than usual going in.

The HAR+IV model, which debiases the VIX with past realized vol, forecasts 22.8% for the next month (pure HAR-RV: 24.8%). The gap between market and model is +5.5 points, in the '4 to 6' bucket. Historically in that bucket the forward premium averaged +3.7 points and was positive 81% of the time.

sections.title: Term structure
paragraphs: Curve: VIX9D 29.6, VIX 28.3, VIX3M 26.3, VIX6M 26.9, VIX1Y 26.1. VIX / VIX3M = 1.076, backwardation (stress: near-term vol above deferred). The curve has been inverted on 8% of days since 2015.

The forward vol between 30 and 91 days is 25.2%: that is what the market charges for month two and three, below spot VIX. VVIX at 115 and CBOE SKEW at 142 (29th pct) describe the vol-of-vol and tail pricing.

sections.title: Cross-asset
paragraphs: Among the assets with a CBOE implied index, Gold has the richest options (IV 35.8% vs realized 34.3%, +1.6 points) and Nasdaq 100 the cheapest (-7.5 points). Realized vol percentiles over one year: S&P 500 99th, Nasdaq 100 99th, Russell 2000 99th, Euro Stoxx 50 84th, WTI Crude 57th, Gold 84th, Silver 67th, Natural Gas 81th, Brent Crude 72th, Copper 83th, Aluminium 51th, Wheat 50th, Corn 67th, Soybeans 52th.

sections.title: WTI crude
paragraphs: OVX at 48.0 (28th pct 1y) against 53.1% realized on the front future. The CLZ27 / CLZ28 calendar spread is +6.0%: the curve is in backwardation.
Samuelson effect today: CLF27 (0.9 months out) realizes 42% against 25% for CLZ27 at 12 months. News hits the front of the curve; the back is anchored by marginal cost.
Selling crude vol at the OVX level earned +4.0 points on average in backwardation (positive 73% of days, worst -40.3) versus +0.5 in the other regime.

sections.title: Scheduled events
paragraphs: Next FOMC decision: 2026-12-09 (13 days). It is outside the 9-day window, so VIX9D carries no identifiable event premium today.

Over 95 meetings since 2015 the term structure priced an average 0.68% move and the S&P realized 0.80% (ratio 1.09, realized above implied on 35% of meetings, max ratio 6.3x on 2024-06-12). Event vol is fairly priced; the generic month is not: the carry lives in the days with no scheduled news.

sections.title: Skew (SPY 30d, last snapshot)
paragraphs: Snapshot 2026-11-26: ATM 23.7%, 25-delta put 29.1%, 25-delta call 19.2%, risk reversal -9.88 points, butterfly +0.48. 22 snapshot day(s) in the history so far.

ideas.title: Sell WTI vol at the OVX level
ideas.instrument: USO / CL 1m variance at the OVX (crude ATM vol sits about 5% below OVX)
ideas.thesis: OVX 48.0 against 53.1% realized. In backwardation the crude variance premium averaged +4.0 points, positive 73% of days. Scarcity regimes have paid the seller.

ideas.title: Sell 1-month S&P variance at the VIX
ideas.instrument: 1m variance swap at the VIX, held to expiry (the premium sits in the wings, not at the money)
ideas.thesis: With the curve in backwardation, the forward premium (VIX today minus realized over the next 21 days) averaged +3.3 points in this bucket and was positive 79% of the time.

ideas.title: Sell the 1-month ATM S&P straddle, delta-hedged daily
ideas.instrument: SPX / SPY 1m ATM straddle at the ATM vol (about 0.8 x VIX), hedged at each close
ideas.condition: VIX - HAR+IV gap in the '4 to 6' bucket (+5.5 pts today)
ideas.thesis: The market charges +5.5 points over the debiased model. In this bucket the straddle kept -0.11% of spot per trade after hedge costs, 52% winners.

stats.unconditional: all 262 trades since 2005: -0.14% avg, 54% hit, worst -9.8% (Sep 2008)

method: Ideas are ranked by historical conditional expectation divided by the historical worst case in the same regime (expected P&L per unit of tail). Conditioning variables: the VIX minus HAR+IV gap bucket, the VIX / VIX3M curve bucket, the WTI Dec/Dec curve regime, the FOMC calendar. Gross of financing, net of hedge costs where stated.
caveats: Free data: Yahoo Finance closes and CBOE indices. Option quotes are delayed; implied vols are rebuilt from mids with Black-76.
Conditional statistics are in-sample averages over overlapping daily windows; treat small buckets as indicative.

The straddle backtest sells at the S&P ATM vol (VXO / sqrt(30/22) to 2021, then VIX x a ratio modelled on VIX and SKEW), with 1 bp hedge cost and 0.5 vol point bid-ask; no margin, no financing. Sold at the VIX it would look far better: VIX prices the skew, an ATM straddle does not get paid for it.
